name: hop
description: Usage skill for the git worktree manager "hop" (nuthatch)

interface.shortDescription: Usage skill for the git worktree manager hop
interface.longDescription: A plugin distributing a skill for safely using hop (nuthatch) — which moves, creates, deletes, and lists per-branch git worktrees non-interactively — from a coding agent.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use hop to manage worktrees. Don't edit in the root clone — do your work in the per-branch worktree.
